decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The details of cycle parking proposed comply with the requirements of with UDP policy T.1.4, and Appendix 3 and promote the take up of more sustainable modes of transport as encouraged by UDP policy IMP.1.1, ENV-B.1.1 and T.1.2.
description: Following approval for demolition of existing houses, social club and some retail premises and the comprehensive redevelopment of Key Site 1 with the erection of a mixed use development comprising multiplex cinema, leisure and recreational facilities, town square, large retail units, shops, restaurants, offices, hotel, health and fitness centre, creche, medical and dentistry centre, private residential, key worker housing, together with improvements to surrounding access routes, improvements to public transport including a new pedestrian link to Hounslow Central Underground Station and the  construction of two new road links between the site and the High Street, and the construction of car parks, access and service roads and landscaping - details submitted pursuant to condition 19 - before development of the residential elements of the development commences, details of cycle parking for residents shall be submitted to and approved be the Local Planning Authority, and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the residential development and permanently retained thereafter
